mapper.select: SELECT checkpoint_millis FROM search_sync_checkpoint WHERE checkpoint_name = #{checkpointName} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_sync_checkpoint ( checkpoint_name, checkpoint_millis, last_success_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{checkpointName}, #{checkpointMillis}, NOW(), NULL, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE checkpoint_millis = VALUES(checkpoint_millis), last_success_at = NOW(), last_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE search_sync_checkpoint SET last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE checkpoint_name = #{checkpointName}
